methods.name: open_card
methods.signature: open_card(name: str, anchors: str, prices: str, cap_tier: str, window_h: int, appeal_fee: int) -> int
methods.doc: Open a card with its five anchors, prices, cap tier, review window and appeal fee, and fund its pool with the value sent.

methods.name: fund_card
methods.doc: Open to anyone, on purpose: a pool is anyone's to add to, and the funder is recorded. Adds the value sent to the pool.

methods.name: claim
methods.doc: Submit a description of work. It reserves nothing yet and enters the card's review window.

methods.name: veto
methods.doc: Owner only, inside the review window, once and for any reason. The claim is closed and nothing is paid.

methods.name: size
methods.doc: Open to anyone, on purpose: a size should not wait for the contributor to come back, and the caller is recorded. Runs only after the review window and only when the pool holds the cap price. Places the claim on the ladder, looks the price up on the card and credits it. An appealed claim is read again with the ladder shown largest first.

methods.name: appeal
methods.doc: Claimant only. Pays the card's exact appeal fee for one re-read with the ladder reversed; the second reading replaces the first.

methods.name: withdraw
methods.doc: The only payout: a top-level transfer of the caller's own balance.

methods.name: get_card
methods.doc: Anchors, prices, cap, pool, window and counts. {"found": false} when there is none; card 0 answers the totals.

methods.name: get_claim
methods.doc: Work text, readings, tier, verdict and pay, with the claimant's withdrawable balance. {"found": false} when there is none.

methods.name: list_claims
methods.signature: list_claims(card_id: int, offset: int, limit: int) -> str
methods.doc: Claims newest first: one card's, or across every card when card_id is 0.
